market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.4m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Venezuela production was 1,021 tb/d Feb 2026 and 1,095 tb/d Mar 2026 per secondary sources. April exports surged to 1.23m bpd including inventory drawdown, but actual production remains around 1.1m. To reach 1.4m would require ~30% growth from current levels. EIA expects 30-40% rise vs baseline 900K but full-year average. Plausible by year-end but not majority-likely.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Pace of Repsol/Chevron-driven production recovery and license stability
